caption: The drawing is set against a beige background and depicts three objects arranged near the top center of the page. The uppermost object is an ornate, symmetrical, elongated oval design rendered in yellow, suggesting gold, with detailed filigree patterns. At its center are three rounded blue stones clustered together, with two small green stones adjacent to them. Below this object are two lightly sketched outlines: the left one shows a front view of a vertically oriented, pendant-like shape with two main lobes and a scalloped edge, with an attached ring at the top and bottom. The right outline is a side profile of the same pendant, depicting its three-dimensional shape and some internal detailing. The lower two outlines contain no coloring and are made with fine, faint lines. The rest of the page is blank.
title: Clasp for Necklace
